hooks.text: 敌人攻击要按节奏格挡，并用精准格挡反击
hooks.excerpt: This is a roguelike rhythm action game that requires you to block and counter (accurate block) enemy attacks at the right moment.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 同标签武器激活羁绊，多余同武器升星后可不装备触发
hooks.excerpt: They also have Synergy tags, and activating the same tags grants characters special effects. When you have extra copies of the same weapon, the weapon will be starred up activating its Synergy effects without having to equip the weapon.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用不同角色通过指定难度与关卡才能拼出完整故事
hooks.excerpt: you will need to use different characters to clear the required difficulty levels and stages to unlock each character's story chapters and get a glimpse into the whole story.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
